_comment: GENERATED FILE - do not hand-edit. Regenerate with:
python scripts/stack/stack.py inventory --write
and verify with `inventory --check`, which the pre-commit check
scripts/checks/check-project-configs.ps1 and the ci.yml `stack-driver` job both run.
Canonical service inventory for the ai-stack health checkers - the single
source of truth for WHAT to check, to stop the checkers from drifting.
Consumed by scripts/recovery/status_check.py (data-driven liveness loop) and by
scripts/checks/stack-watchdog.ps1, which routes EVERY container repair through the
`projects` map below, so a plane split cannot leave remediation pointing at a
project that no longer owns the container - which is exactly what Part K did,
silently, for 22 self-heal paths between 2026-08-21 and 2026-08-28.
WHERE EACH FIELD COMES FROM (sl-driver-parity, 2026-09-19):
projects.*            stack.manifest.toml - the compose file, the --env-file and
the runnable command line. A plane the manifest marks
`manual` (the portal) is deliberately absent: the watchdog
must not auto-repair a plane a human starts by hand.
container / service   the compose RENDER, with every declared profile switched on
profile               so profile-gated containers appear too. Rendering WITHOUT
profiles is why the old verifier never saw
openbrain-idea-refinery.
critical, host_health scripts/lib/stack-services.curated.json - hand-owned
stale_pool_guard,     judgement, plus the plane GROUPING and the row order,
note                  which no machine can derive. Edit the SIDECAR, then
re-run `inventory --write`.
PROFILE FIELDS, and the one case where a row's `profile` is NOT derived:
A row's `profile` normally comes from the compose render. For a plane whose
compose file is a PINNED SUBMODULE, the manifest may name profiles the pinned
commit does not carry yet - OB1's research / wiki / notebook are exactly that
today (gitlink 5005197 declares only idea-refinery). There the `profile` in
the curated sidecar is a DECLARATION: `inventory --check` prints it as
`[declared, not rendered]` instead of calling it stale, and starts verifying
it against the render the moment the gitlink bumps. For every plane whose
compose lives in this repo the two must agree, and a mismatch is drift.
IMPORTANT: 'container' is the docker container NAME (use with `docker inspect`).
Some compose SERVICE keys differ from the container name (search: redis ->
search-redis, gateway -> search-gateway, vpn -> search-vpn); the 'service' field
is present exactly where they differ, and `docker compose` wants that key.
Open Brain is a SEPARATE compose project (open-brain) and a submodule; a checkout
without it renders nothing here and `inventory --check` says so by name rather
than passing quietly.
file     - compose file, repo-root-relative. null means the project owns NO
services and nothing can be started in it (only 'ai-stack').
env_file - extra --env-file, or null when the project needs none.
compose  - the same thing spelled as a human-runnable command line.

ai-stack.note: PURE NETWORK ANCHOR since Part K.5b (2026-08-21): owns the shared llm-net / app-net / default networks and ZERO services. `docker compose up -d <anything>` here exits 1 with 'no such service'. file=null marks it unstartable; no container row points at it.

open-brain.note: env_file is deliberately null: compose's project directory here is OB1/docker, so it auto-loads OB1/docker/.env. Passing the ROOT .env would override it with the wrong values. PROFILE-GATED since 2026-09-19 (sl-ob1-profiles): a bare `config` or `up` renders only the 20 core + always-on-scheduled services, so any tool reading this file must pass --profile research --profile wiki --profile notebook --profile idea-refinery to see all 30. The rows below carry a `profile` field wherever that applies.

agent-org.note: env_file is deliberately null, same as open-brain: compose's project directory is agent-org/docker, so it auto-loads agent-org/docker/.env. Passing the ROOT .env would override it with the wrong values. The workers/cloud slices are PROFILE-GATED: a bare `config` or `up` renders only the six always-on services, so any tool reading this file must pass --profile workers --profile cloud to see the rest.

core.note: PROFILE-GATED since 2026-09-19 (stack-layers 2.5 / D8): this ONE container is produced by service `openwebui` under the `gpu` profile (this host) or `openwebui-stock` under the `stock` profile (a fresh clone). No 'service' field, because the right key depends on which profile the deployment runs; the implied key `openwebui` is correct wherever COMPOSE_PROFILES includes gpu, which is every host that runs the watchdog. Any tool rendering this plane must pass --profile gpu --profile tailscale (or have COMPOSE_PROFILES in .env) or it sees only openwebui-stock + openwebui-backup.

PROFILE-GATED (`tailscale` profile, which requires `gpu`). Absent from the frontend render on a deployment that does not run it; stack.ps1 health and stack-watchdog.ps1 skip their tailnet checks in that case (Test-TailscaleDeployed).
LiteLLM front door (holds the llama-cpp / llama-cpp-embed aliases). No host_health: llm-net is internal so host :4000 is inert; liveliness is in-network (http://llm-gateway:8080/health/liveliness).
B2 admission controller between LiteLLM and the upstreams (llm-backend-net only; liveness via docker exec /healthz)
Admin-UI sidecar (tailnet :8445/ui + litellm.devinveller.ai); serves no inference

search.note: Mullvad egress + kill-switch; ALL search-plane traffic

notebook.note: being retired (Quartz workbench); still live for podcasts
open-notebook DB; WS-only, no HTTP health

openbrain.note: stale-pool dependency: if this restarts after openbrain-mcp, mcp must be restarted
holds a long-lived DB connection that does NOT auto-reconnect; OWUI tool 500s / 'Broken pipe' when stale
MCP->OpenAPI bridge Open WebUI tools call

Ops door (PLAN §1.4): a second openbrain-gateway instance with its own OPS_GATEWAY_KEY, allowlisting the agent_memory_* tools for HOST processes that cannot reach openbrain-mcp (it publishes no host port). Stateless - no backup sidecar. Not critical: without it host callers lose the agent-memory lane; nothing else degrades.
the clock for the whole scheduled chain

chain tail. Its enrichment and audio steps reach PROFILED services (RESEARCH_URL -> openbrain-research, ON_BASE -> open_notebook), so a digest chain run without --profile research --profile notebook produces no episode.

Idea Refinery drain (cron 03:00 UTC). Added 2026-09-19 with sl-ob1-profiles: it was the one live open-brain container absent from this file (documentation/notes/stack-services-unlisted-containers.md), and giving the OB1 render its profiles would otherwise have turned that documented gap into a pre-commit failure. sl-driver-parity reached the same row from the other side and the reason is worth keeping: the pre-commit verifier rendered WITHOUT profiles, so this container was invisible to it and the watchdog refused to route a repair for a container that had been up for days.

backups.note: weekly GGUF-store tar; empty LM_MODELS_BACKUP_INTERVAL disables
Worker journal tarball sidecar (profile-gated with the pool it serves).
Worker journal tarball sidecar (profile-gated with the pool it serves).

agent-org.note: The org's whole operator surface. Its healthcheck uses mmctl, not curl - a curl-based one reported healthy while the server was unusable (see memory: mattermost-mobile-thread-bug).
The governed org bus - orchestrator, gates, workers. Holds a long-lived DB connection; see stale_pool_guard on openbrain-mcp for the same class of failure.
Postgres behind agent-bridge: efforts, gates, constraints, audit.
Worker pool slot 1. Stateless BY DESIGN - the flail guard forks a fresh session; what persists is curated memory, not context.
open-terminal executor for worker 1. GIT_DISCOVERY_ACROSS_FILESYSTEM=1 lives here.
Git proxy for the worker pool. Hard-denies pushes to main/master (production-branch guard).
Egress proxy for the cloud slice.
Cloud LiteLLM slice; profile-gated and normally down.
Spend ledger for the cloud slice.
